name: Poisson Meshlet-Based (PMB) Extraction
aliases: Real-Time Meshlet Extraction from Scalar Volumes
definition: A real-time isosurface extraction method that partitions scalar volumes into larger blocks and extracts non-trivial persistent meshlets compatible with mesh shader pipelines, improving rendering efficiency over trivial small-voxel approaches.
summary: Poisson Meshlet-Based Extraction is a real-time isosurface method that partitions volumes into hierarchical subblocks to generate persistent meshlet geometry buffers, improving efficiency over trivial voxel approaches.
